plugins.name: feature-flow-lite
plugins.description: A capped subagent pipeline for features and fixes: Opus writes the acceptance criteria and orchestrates four Haiku roles (investigator, implementor, simplifier, reviewer).

plugins.name: figma-flow
plugins.description: Turn Figma frames into React that matches them: a skill that looks, then measures, and a mod that saves Figma exports to disk and holds commits until the measurement passes.

plugins.name: figma-setup
plugins.description: Sets a React repo up to build from Figma and check the result: export scripts, an exact-value test, the mapping rules, and one worked example.
